text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Aston Machan's performance in the Sprinters Stakes remained burned into the memories of many people.
choice_data_list: (If only this could give a push toward making it an official mascot...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With those feelings in mind, as I was writing an email
to request making it an official mascot once again—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And so, take this!
Thank you for all your hard work!
Please, accept it without hesitation!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without really understanding what was going on,
I was handed a box of chocolates
in a luxurious wrap.
choice_data_list: W-what's wrong all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Simple and clear!
It is decided! This year, Tazuna and I shall distribute chocolates of appreciation to all staff members!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Especially you! As Aston Machan's current Trainer, your workload must inevitably be immense!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: On top of daily race-related duties, they're also doing promotional work to raise Aston Machan's profile!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: The bronze statue was rejected after deliberation, but... aside from updating the 4-panel blog, we'll distribute handmade dolls! And tour the shopping district in costume mascots!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I truly admire your extraordinary love
for Aston Machan!
Please continue to support her with all your heart!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Well then, that's all for now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chairwoman Akikawa departed like a hurricane.
Feeling a faint sense of joy from being
praised and acknowledged by her—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Maybe I should prepare some chocolate for Aston Machan? As I was thinking that—"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Aston Machan came over, on the verge of tears.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I got fewer friendship chocolates
than in previous years...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Once everyone sees Machan's face,
they finally remember."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"I thought I brought enough for the whole class..."
"I'll bring more tomorrow, so I'm really sorry!"
...she said!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Does Chan have no presence, after all?
*Sniff*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan slumped her shoulders.
I was about to suggest going to buy her favorite chocolate,
opening my mouth to speak—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"I must make my presence felt even more.
To do that, I simply have to show everyone Aston Machan."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In other words...
let's make Chan-Ma chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And with that.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Drawing Chan-chan's face on the white chocolate with a chocolate pen.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Slowly, quietly...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh, I went over the lines...
This is surprisingly difficult...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hastily mass-producing Aston Machan chocolates—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hellooo,
I am Aston Machan.
Pleased to meet you~.
choice_data_list: I look forward to working with yooou!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hey, what's that?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Now...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Handed them out in front of the school gate.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
I think that's just about all of them handed out.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure they remember Machan very well now.
Next year will be completely safe and secure.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...Air Groove-san should be arriving
any moment now. I ought to take my leave."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: We got a few weird looks, but she seemed satisfied, so I'll call it a win. As we were getting ready to head back—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that's right.
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Even so, it's the very last
Curren-chan chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Please give Aston Machan your
warmest support~!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu,
it might be a little difficult to eat, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I carefully brought home the Aston Machan chocolate she gently handed me, making sure not to break it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"I was so sad that you forgot about me
that I completely forgot to hand it to you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon accepting it, I found it was carefully wrapped chocolate.
It seemed she went out of her way to prepare it for me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
“...Well, you see,
there's a secret hidden behind it.”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's a secret you'll understand once you eat it.
Please enjoy it in your room.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...It's something very special.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That night.
I returned to my room and took a bite.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was sweet, soft milk chocolate
with caramel filled in the center.
